task.title: M4: Cytoscape dependency graph with compound directory nodes and cycle highlighting
task.description:
Build the dependency graph view with Cytoscape.js. Files are nodes nested inside compound nodes for their directories (from modules[] of kind dir); directories collapse and expand, with edges aggregated to the collapsed parent. Strongly connected components are detected and the edges in cycles are highlighted; a side panel lists cycles by size. Layout must stay usable on Capacitor-sized graphs, so start collapsed to top-level directories.

Acceptance criteria:
- Graph renders from snapshot.modules and snapshot.edges via the DataSource; initial state is collapsed to the first directory level.
- Expanding or collapsing a compound node re-aggregates edges and preserves the layout of the rest of the graph.
- Cycle detection (Tarjan) runs in the client, highlights cycle edges, and the cycle list focuses the graph on click.
- Node tooltip shows file metrics; edge tooltip shows the import count aggregated.
- Capacitor's graph is interactive at the top level within a reasonable time (noted in the PR), and the SCC routine has unit tests.
